zh: 先固定 A 的件数 q。q 件物品能达到的最大总重量就是最重的那 q 件；如果连这个都不能严格超过其余物品，那么任何 q 件的选法都不合法。
所以让 q 从 1 开始递增，第一次让“最重的 q 件”严格超过剩余重量的 q 就是最少件数；同时这组最重的 q 件正好也是该件数下总重量最大的选法，两个目标一并满足。
求出总重量，把重量降序排序后依次放进 A，每放一件检查已选重量是否大于“总重量 − 已选重量”，一旦成立就停止；把选出的重量按升序输出。
en: Fix the number q of items in A first. The heaviest total that q items can reach is that of the q heaviest items; if even that does not strictly exceed the rest, no choice of q items works.

So increase q from 1; the first q for which the q heaviest items strictly outweigh the rest is the minimum count, and those same q heaviest items also give the largest total weight for that count, satisfying both goals at once.

Compute the total weight, sort the weights in descending order and add them to A one by one, checking after each whether the chosen weight exceeds total minus chosen, and stop as soon as it does; print the chosen weights in ascending order.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Take weights in descending order until the chosen weight is strictly greater than the unchosen weight; reverse the chosen prefix to output it in ascending order.

## Proof of correctness

For a fixed count q, the largest possible total weight comes from the q largest items. If this upper bound still does not exceed the remaining weight, no choice of q items is valid; the first time it strictly exceeds, q is minimal, and this prefix also reaches the largest total for that q, satisfying the second objective. Printing in ascending order only changes the presentation.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
